description: Borne Incendie is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région des Pays de la Loire. Location of fire terminals and poles in Angers Loire Métropole. ADDRESS: Address CODINSEE: INSEE code MUNICIPALITY: Commune DEBIT: Post flow rate DIAMETRE: Diameter EQUIPDISPO: Equipment available IDVOIE: Track identifier NAMEVOIE: Track name NUMPOMPIER: SDIS Identifier PRESSURE: Static pressure measured TYPE: Type. Coverage: Région des Pays de la Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Fire terminal" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région des Pays de la Loire. Its keywords include pompiers, incendie, urbanisme-logement, hydrant, lutte-anti-incendie. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, SHP, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
